theme.title: Rotation: Value/Defensives → Growth
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+3.18%) and Technology (+2.62%) led the market today, while Energy (-2.80%) and Utilities (-1.45%) brought up the rear. Growth sectors outpaced the rest, averaging +2.21% versus -0.69% for defensives and -0.72% for value, consistent with risk appetite favoring higher-beta names. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +2.26% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at +0.71%. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at +0.52%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 0.41% to 14.87, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 0.05% to $4,397.90, crude oil was little changed at $92.30, and bitcoin gained 6.50% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
